[[Gobrech Stonefoot]] is the armorer in [[Central Transfer Chamber]]. He crafts cross-profession armor pieces as well as stand alone profession-specific pieces commonly referred to as [[Deldrimor armor]].

==Locations==
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**{{NPC location|Central Transfer Chamber}}

==Dialogue==
Before attaining rank 5 on the Deldrimor title track:
:''"By the beard of the Great Dwarf! Look at this. It seems <character name> has decided to do a little spelunking as a nice retreat. Am I right? We have enough problems of our own without you coming around to stir things up. Now leave me in peace, and make room for customers who can rightfully claim to be a [[Deldrimor rank|Bold Delver]]"''

After attaining rank 5 or higher on the Deldrimor title track:
{{Armorer dialogue}}
